summary: The run's deaths=5 kill_credits=5 are the five Mav torpedo bombers shot down by Dunlap, Northampton and SaltLakeCity after they dropped; no ship sank and not one point of the mission's 2596.8 damage is attributable to a torpedo. All five torpedoes entered the water and swam at 30.9 m/s, and all five missed.

host_steps.note: Second argument is the literal 1.0 from 009D107A FLD1 / 009D1084 SUB ESP,8 / 009D1087 FSTP [ESP+4], capping the climb at class+1ECh * 1.0 = 0.1854 rad for the Mav. Unbound in this host.

The low arm, taken when unitY <= 20.0 (00CE3930): altitude 1000.0 (00CE3804) with the same literal 1.0 reference, then cmd+2C0h = state+18h and cmd+2CCh = 2. This is the climb-away proper and the aircraft that ditch at 69.6 m/s are in exactly this altitude band with nothing running it.

torpedo_fate.open: Whether anything in the chain leads a moving target over the roughly 23 seconds of run is unread. 009D1360 writes approach+A0h (the fall lead) and approach+98h (the run time), and 009D3D12 reads +98h as the bias of the engagement estimate at +F8h; whether either reaches the commanded heading is not established. The commanded heading is approach+94h, the bearing to the plan target at approach+ACh/+B0h, plus the sector offset approach+5Ch.

goaway_tick.structure: high = unitY > state+20h (009D0F3C JBE -> 0); 009D0C10 heading update; countdown state+28h -= dt while approach+90h < state+24h - 100.0; state+30h += dt; re-seed state+34h = jitter(3.0, 6.0), state+28h = jitter(row+10h, row+14h) + state+34h, state+30h = -state+34h/2 when state+28h < 0 and high; then the manoeuvre window state+30h < state+34h selects the arm.
goaway_tick.window_arm: 009FB800(state+1Ch, 1.0) and a roll cmd+2C4h = clamp(2 * state+2Ch * state+30h, -1.2, 1.2) with cmd+2CCh = 1 when unitY > 20.0; otherwise 009FB800(1000.0, 1.0) with cmd+2C0h = state+18h and cmd+2CCh = 2.
goaway_tick.post_window_arm: 009FB800(state+1Ch, 1.0) always; then cmd+2C0h = state+18h with mode 2 when high, else cmd+2C4h = 0.0 with mode 1.
goaway_tick.unread_dependencies: 009FD570 and the vtable[0] call before it, which together produce the break-off bearing, and 007F0280s output triple at this call site. Both must be read before 009D0F10 can be bound: substituting either commands a heading that is not the image's. 007F0280 is shared with the aim tick sector probe and both attack-run ticks, so its contract is worth reading once for all of them.
goaway_tick.completion_predicate: 009D3150 is a pure range test, approach+90h > state+24h, with an optional * 0.4 arm gated on ctl+369h and the global at 00E17BF2, both off in this host. No altitude condition, unlike the dive bomb 009C7F00 that cost agent/cc8-dive-bomb a run. The aimclass run reads enters=1 break_off_24h=700.0 range_peak_in_goaway=382.2 done_last=0 on every aircraft, so a binding will not be cut off after one tick.
goaway_tick.geometry_009d0c10: state+18h = AddWrappedAngle(unitHeading, turn), where turn = clamp(SubtractWrappedAngle(bearing, unitHeading), -0.5235988, +0.5235988) (00CEC728 / 00CEC724, +/- DEG(30)), pushed by probe * 0.6981317401 (00D20CC0, a double, DEG(40)) when the terrain probe from 007F0280 disagrees with the turn sign. state+2Ch, the +/-1 side the enter draws, is an argument to the bearing call, which is what makes the break-off turn left or right.
goaway_tick.probe_substitution_is_safe: 009D0C96-009D0CAA zero the three 007F0280 out-slots with XORPS/MOVSS immediately before the call, and the probe term is -p[0]*p[1]*p[2]. A no-hit answer leaves it 0, and the nudge at 009D0D50 needs a strict sign, so an inert probe changes nothing. That is how the host already models the same routine for the aim tick.
goaway_tick.remaining_cost: NOT "bind 009D0F10". Step 1 is reading 009FD570 (body 009FD570-009FDEDE, 2414 bytes, SIX callers 007B5AF0, 009A3CF0, 009AD480, 009B5760, 009C47D0, 009D0C10; fourteen callees including BSP_Matrix_Multiply4x4) and the approach vtable[0] break-off-point routine it is fed. Step 2 is then a short window: the tick, the enter, the predicate and the inert probe are all already read. Step 1 pays for six call sites rather than one.
